criteria.title: Drop-in source artifact
criteria.description: The requested Java file is readable, compiles against the bundled app and offline SDK model, and preserves the starter controller's drop-in public contract.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Earned reward integrity
criteria.description: The wallet is credited only after the earned-reward callback, with the SDK-provided type and amount unchanged, and receives nothing for show, dismissal, or presentation failure alone.

criteria.title: Callback safety and inventory recovery
criteria.description: UI changes originating in SDK callbacks are marshalled through the view's UI dispatcher, and dismissal or presentation failure retires the used ad and begins replacement loading.

criteria.title: Placement loading and readiness
criteria.description: The controller requests the configured rewarded placement, registers full-screen callbacks, never auto-presents, and exposes the opt-in action only when inventory is ready.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.

criteria.title: Explicit, one-shot presentation
criteria.description: A ready ad is shown only by the explicit watch-button entry point and cannot be reused or shown twice while being consumed.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
